dict.string: Take a photo of your crew to share on the challenge, or one for your profile.
Save a crew member’s contact card to your contacts. Rep Crew never reads your address book.
Rep Crew reads your workouts and their active energy so you can match them to your challenges. It uses Health’s own times and calories and never changes them.
Save each timed set to Health as a strength workout.
Save crew photos to your photo library.
